## Goal
Add web/src/pages/developers/cli/index.astro: a plain reference of every CLI command and flag. Generate the data once from Click introspection into web/src/pages/developers/cli/_commands.json (a tiny script is allowed at tools-free path: put it in the test file as a check that the JSON matches the live CLI). Link from the existing developers page is in-house: ask in Questions; do not edit developers/index.astro.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Every factual statement about the product cites the source file:line it came from; nothing about features that are not on main.
- Plain words (target readers are older non-technical people for user docs; developers for dev docs).
- No real personal data; examples use Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL.
- `cd web && pnpm build && pnpm check` and the content check pass; no client JavaScript (the site is script-free).
- Create no files outside the allowed paths (no scratch, backup or .new/.tmp copies).
